HIGHLIGHTS More than three years into the crisis in Gaza, and one year into the ceasefire, displaced families are facing a fourth winter in tents. Although humanitarian assistance and commercial supplies increased following the October 2025 ceasefire, they remain insufficient against the scale of needs, and the crisis is far from over. Some 1.4 million people, or two-thirds of the population, are acutely food insecure, with deteriorating weather conditions expected to further deplete their… Fuente: ReliefWeb - Emergencias.

item.title: Broadening the role of RNA: A messenger, a mediator and now a condensate coordinator
item.description: New research about condensates—cellular compartments that act as hubs for facilitating biological reactions—continues to reveal novel insights into how cells function. Among those continuing to push the field forward are members of the Marine Biological Laboratory's condensate consortium, including Amy Gladfelter, a professor at Duke University and current co-director of the MBL physiology course, and former MBL physiology course student and past MBL Whitman fellow Dragomir Milovanovic, a professor at the Charité Berlin University Institute of Biochemistry. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Louisiana farmer wins 13-year land dispute after neighbours clear trees; court awards him $59,966
item.description: In a landmark ruling, Louisiana farmer Benjamin Lee Bird emerged victorious in a lengthy 13-year battle over a disputed land strip. The court upheld his ownership, leading to a damages award against his neighbours for their actions, which included tree removal and altering drainage systems on Bird's land. The appeals court confirmed his rights, adjusting the compensation to $59,966. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
